notes: The only genuinely contested unit is the supplied *that* at t004: it is folded onto ποιήσω under rules 40 and 85 on the ground that the deliberative subjunctive is itself the subordinated verbal, so a source token carries the subordination. Marking it `added` remains defensible, but rule 86 is scoped to a finite indicative.
ἀναβλέψω → *receive … sight* is headed on *sight* under rules 17 and 91, matching 18:42 and 18:43; the ἀνα- preverb has no separate English particle here, so rule 106 splits nothing off.
